description: This is a Java interface defining DAO operations for TaxClass entities, including methods to list tax classes by merchant store, and retrieve tax classes by code.

classes.name: TaxClassDao
classes.description: Java interface for data access operations related to TaxClass entities within the sales manager system.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxClass objects associated with the specified MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a TaxClass based on its unique code.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a TaxClass based on its code and associated MerchantStore.
